Tooltip_BF_SeringaVazia: Clean syringe. Base for every injectable.
Tooltip_BF_SeringaUsada: Must be sterilized: with alcohol or bleach anywhere, or by fire (lit stove, fireplace or campfire within 3 tiles).
Tooltip_BF_Monjaro: 24 h. Loses 1.2 kg/day, 60%% less hunger. <LINE> Side effect: tires 50%% faster.
Tooltip_BF_Ozempic: 24 h. Loses 0.6 kg/day, 40%% less hunger. <LINE> Side effect: tires 35%% faster.
Tooltip_BF_Deca: 48 h. +15%% strength (carry weight and melee damage). <LINE> Side effect: hunger 80%% faster and a shout every 3 h that attracts zombies. From the 3rd anabolic or slimming dose your hair falls out.
Tooltip_BF_Trembolona: 36 h. +10%% strength (carry weight and melee damage). <LINE> Side effect: hunger 60%% faster and a shout every 3 h that attracts zombies. From the 3rd anabolic or slimming dose your hair falls out.
Tooltip_BF_Morfina: 8 h. Cuts 80%% of pain and relieves muscle strain. <LINE> From the 3rd dose: paranoia (phantom zombie sounds) and growing depression.
Tooltip_BF_Adrenalina: 1 h. Near infinite stamina, keen hearing, cuts panic and acts as Adrenaline Junkie. <LINE> Afterwards: extreme tiredness and, for 2 h, cuts bleed more. <LINE> Recipe: alcohol, black sage, tobacco, sedative, poppy and comfrey.
Tooltip_BF_Rebite: 6 h. Tires 90%% less and sees in the dark like Cat's Eyes. <LINE> Afterwards: for 6 h sleep recovers only 40%% of tiredness.
Tooltip_BF_Dipirona: 4 h. Relieves muscle strain and 30%% of pain.
Tooltip_BF_Metanfetamina: Bottle with 10 doses. 6 h: removes muscle strain fast and tires 70%% less. <LINE> Paranoia from the 1st dose, addictive from the 3rd. Cooked at the lab bench, next to a lit fire, with glassware and a mortar.
Tooltip_BF_Tadala: 6 h. Relieves muscle strain. <LINE> Afterwards: extreme sadness.
Tooltip_BF_Benegripe: Cures a cold over 8 h and prevents a new one for 12 h.
Tooltip_BF_Lolo: Solvent-soaked rag, 5 sniffs. Kills nicotine craving and relieves stress. <LINE> Causes nausea, drunkenness and coughing for 1 h.
Tooltip_BF_BenegripeForte: Cures a cold over 4 h and prevents a new one for 36 h.
Tooltip_BF_VitaminaC: 6 h cold protection and a little less tiredness. Weaker than pharmacy vitamins.
Tooltip_BF_Creatina: 6 h. +50%% Strength XP. No side effects.
Tooltip_BF_Whey: Bottle with 10 doses. 6 h per dose: +50%% Fitness XP and less hunger. Made with 10 L of milk, sugar and salt in a pot; returns the jar when empty.
Tooltip_BF_KitAntidoping: Right click the kit with another player within 3 tiles: tests what they took in the last 48 h and produces a report. Consumes the kit.
Tooltip_BF_Vidraria: Flasks, hose and funnel. Needed for Meth and to build the lab bench.
Tooltip_BF_Laboratorio: Lab bench. Every medicine and injectable can only be prepared within 3 tiles of it. Meth also needs a lit fire nearby. Building it requires Carpentry 2 and Pharmacy 1.
Tooltip_BF_LivroHorta: Teaches the growing seasons of medicinal herbs. Readers harvest one extra herb per plant and earn Pharmacy XP.
Tooltip_BF_Resultado: Result of an anti-doping test. Right click to read.
Tooltip_BF_AlcoolIsopropilico: Bottle with 1 L of alcohol. Sterilizes syringes and goes into injectables. Made from 1 L of bleach and 10 L of clean water.
Tooltip_BF_Cafeina: 3 h. Tires 30%% less. Base of the injectables. Made from tobacco and ginseng boiled in 1 L of water, next to a fire.
